title: Seal
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyG' cx='45%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#9fd4f0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#4a90b8'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='url(#bodyG)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='19' ry='14' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='19' fill='#7fc0e0'/>
  <!-- head lighter top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='14' fill='#a5d8ee'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='41' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2a4a66'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='36' rx='1.4' ry='1' fill='#6fa8c8'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M44 43 Q50 48 56 43' stroke='#2a4a66' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='29' r='4' fill='#1e3a52'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='29' r='4' fill='#1e3a52'/>
  <circle cx='43.4' cy='27.6' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.4' cy='27.6' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- whisker dots -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='40' r='0.9' fill='#5a90b0'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='42' r='0.9' fill='#5a90b0'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='42' r='0.9' fill='#5a90b0'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='40' r='0.9' fill='#5a90b0'/>
  <!-- front flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#4a90b8' transform='rotate(18 22 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='62' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#4a90b8' transform='rotate(-18 78 62)'/>
  <!-- tail flippers -->
  <path d='M40 84 L28 92 L34 96 L48 88 Z' fill='#3d7fa6'/>
  <path d='M60 84 L72 92 L66 96 L52 88 Z' fill='#3d7fa6'/>
</svg>
